grammarFocus: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别。
title: The Library Garden: A Community Project
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请仔细阅读，注意原因、结果与让步从句，以及may / might / can的语气差别。
passage:
Last spring, a group of neighbours in a small town decided to turn an empty lot behind the public library into a community garden. The lot was full of rubbish and old tyres, so they organised a clean-up day. More than forty people came, and they collected thirty large bags of rubbish. Because the council wanted to support the project, it provided tools, gloves, and seeds. However, the group still needed money for a water system. They held a bake sale and a quiz night, and together these events raised £600, which was enough to buy pipes, a tap, and a small water tank. The bake sale was especially popular because a local bakery donated cakes and bread. Many people also gave small amounts of money online, and the group was surprised by the generosity of the community.

The garden opened in early summer. Each family could rent a small plot for £15 a year, and the money went towards seeds and tools. Some people grew vegetables like tomatoes and beans, while others planted flowers. The garden quickly became a popular place, and many neighbours met each other for the first time there. Although the weather was often rainy, the gardeners worked hard every weekend. As a result, they harvested more than 250 kilograms of vegetables in the first year. They gave some of the food to a local food bank, which helps families in need. The food bank was very grateful, and it asked the gardeners to continue donating in the future. The garden also attracted bees and butterflies, which made the area more beautiful.

Not everything was easy. A few people complained about the noise from children playing near the garden. The group leader, Maria, said, “We might need to set some quiet hours, but we don’t want to stop children from enjoying the garden.” After a long discussion, they agreed to have quiet hours from 2 to 4 pm on weekdays. This compromise worked well, and the complaints stopped. Maria believes that the garden can bring people together. She says, “You might think a garden is just about plants, but it’s really about community.” She also thinks that the garden might help children learn about nature. The children often help with watering and planting, and they enjoy watching the plants grow.

This year, the group wants to build a small shed for tools. They may receive a grant from the council, but they are not sure yet. If they get the money, they can start building in summer. They also plan to run free gardening classes for beginners. These classes might help more people join the project. The group has written a short guide to share their experience, and two nearby streets are now planning similar gardens. The council might offer advice, but each group must find its own volunteers. The original group hopes more people will join and enjoy gardening. They also want to organise a harvest festival in autumn to celebrate their success.

Maria says that the garden has changed the neighbourhood. People stop to talk, and children learn where food comes from. Although the project takes time and effort, the neighbours feel proud of what they have built together. They believe that the garden can make the area safer and friendlier. Many people now spend more time outdoors, and they have made new friends. The garden has become a symbol of what a community can achieve when people work together.

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 原因从句常用 because 引导，说明原因；结果常用 so 或 as a result 表示；让步用 although 表示“虽然”。may 和 might 表示可能性，might 语气更不确定；can 表示能力或可能性。
grammar.example: Because the council wanted to support the project, it provided tools, gloves, and seeds.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: _______ it was raining, they continued gardening.
questions.explanation: 这里表示让步“虽然下雨，他们继续园艺”，所以用 Although。
questions.evidence: Although the weather was often rainy, the gardeners worked hard every weekend.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The lot was dirty, _______ they cleaned it.
questions.explanation: 这里表示结果“所以”，用 so。
questions.evidence: The lot was full of rubbish and old tyres, so they organised a clean-up day.

questions.prompt: Which sentence shows the most uncertainty?
questions.explanation: might 表示的可能性比 may 更不确定，所以选 might。
questions.evidence: They may receive a grant from the council, but they are not sure yet.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She _______ speak three languages.
questions.evidence: Maria believes that the garden can bring people together.
